Every login and refresh overwrites the activity columns; a login judges on the old values in the same transaction and flags with the trusted snapshot; three reverify routes leave planned. Failure counting uses an atomic reservation in one UPDATE, including the day reset; every real pass clears and advances reverify_fail_epoch (new column, migration); a release undoes only its own reservation when day and epoch match. Merge judgement moves to B1-20c (D10-567). Frozen users-row comparisons exclude five activity columns and gain positive assertions (D10-569, #24); same-device goes first as B1-02zt.
